mcqs.q: When were the Corn Laws repealed?
Why did the Industrial Revolution begin in Britain?
options: Because Britain banned slavery before other countries.
A combination of capital from trade and empire, coal and iron deposits, agricultural improvements, political stability, and a culture of invention.
Because James Watt invented the steam engine.
Lenin personally led the storming of the Winter Palace.

mcqs.q: Why did the American colonies rebel against Britain?
options: The colonists rebelled because they were heavily oppressed and impoverished.
Because Britain banned them from owning land west of the Atlantic.
Lenin personally led the storming of the Winter Palace.
Disputes over taxation without representation after the Seven Years' War, growing colonial identity, and British attempts to tighten imperial control on previously autonomous colonies.
